author: izjust4fun
body:
Hey guys, here's mine and Crazy_Clownz's newest map "Haunted Hallows"!

It's a Halloween themed map (Werewolves vs Vampires) and contains plenty of different features including:

~ Jack o' lantern heads for helmets. (Not sure if this will work.. can a map dev confirm? >.<)
~ Kill rewards (Iron ingots, Exp bottles)
~ Enchantment tables. (Protected)
~ Pre-built monument defences.
~ Mini roller coasters behind spawn.
~ Multiple portals. (You spawn on an island and have the option to run through either one of three portals. There's one that takes you to each monument, and one that takes you to the middle of your teams island.)

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/1zbzkw2xc33l6k7/Haunted_Hallows.zip

Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/cgZ5B

YML: http://pastebin.com/J89uyCNn


Hope you enjoy it!  C:

replies.author: izjust4fun
replies.body: Because it gives players more variety and they can choose different paths to take. For example if there's a guy attacking one of your monuments and you die, you can quickly take the portal to that monument and try cut him off or get to him quicker. Or if you want to get straight into the action, then you can take the middle portal which takes you to the front of your island and you can rush :p It's just basically to give players more options, and it's different so we wanted to try it out! :)
